title: Simple Git CMS configuration
description: config.json, which sits next to the editor's index.html.

siteName.description: The site's name, used as the logo's alt text.

logo.description: An image next to the editor, e.g. ./logo.png. A missing one is simply not shown.

lang.description: Starting interface language. Omit it to follow the browser; whatever the person picks from the menu wins.

repo.description: owner/name of the repository holding the content.

siteUrl.description: The site's address: used for "View on site", and to load images when the editor is on another domain.

timeZone.description: An IANA zone, e.g. Asia/Tokyo. Used for dates shown, image folders and new article ids.

collections.description: Each kind of article the site has, in a directory of its own. With more than one, the sidebar switches between them.

name.description: What the address bar calls this collection (?c=news). Defaults to the last part of dir; has to be different for each collection.

label.description: What this collection is called in the interface, e.g. News.

dir.description: The article directory inside the repository; one <id>.md per article.

url.description: The article's address on the site. {id} is substituted.

imageField.description: The frontmatter field for the article's cover image, e.g. image. Empty (the default) means no cover image control.

preview.description: This collection's preview page on the site. Leave it out and there is no Preview button.

fields.description: Frontmatter fields of this collection's own, each with an input in the article form. A field nobody changes is left in the file exactly as it was.

name.description: The frontmatter key. Not title, description, date, tags, draft or this collection's imageField.

label.description: What the form calls it. Defaults to name.

type.description: text, number, select (one of options), boolean (a checkbox), date (YYYY-MM-DD), or plugin (an input the site provides; see module).

required.description: Publishing needs it filled in; a draft can be saved without it. No effect on a checkbox.

default.description: What a new article starts with. For a select, one of the options' values.

placeholder.description: A hint shown in the empty input.

list.description: Show the value in the sidebar's article list, and let the search find it.

multiline.description: text only: a box with room for several lines.

step.description: number only: what the arrows add or take away.

module.description: plugin only (required): the address of the script that draws this field's input, on the editor's own site, e.g. /editor-plugins/costs.js.

unit.description: number only: shown next to the input, e.g. km. Not written to the file.

options.description: select only: the choices, as values, or as { value, label } to show something other than what the file holds.

dir.description: Where images live in the repository, e.g. public/uploads.

url.description: Their path prefix on the site.

maxWidth.description: Images wider than this are scaled down on upload.

maxFileMB.description: The largest attachment that may be uploaded, in MB. Cloudflare Pages and Workers static assets serve a single file of at most 25 MiB, and GitHub refuses one over 100MB.

skipCiForDrafts.description: Add [skip ci] when saving drafts, so they don't trigger a build.

actions.description: Buttons in the sidebar that start GitHub Actions workflows, e.g. publishing the test site the editor is on to the live site. The GitHub App needs Actions: Read and write.

workflow.description: The workflow's file name (or id). It needs a workflow_dispatch trigger.

ref.description: The branch to run it on. Defaults to branch.

inputs.description: Inputs passed to the workflow, always these values.

confirm.description: What the confirmation asks. Defaults to naming the button, the workflow and the branch.

url.description: Linked once the run succeeds, e.g. the site it published.

blocks.description: Blocks this site defines for itself: HTML tags the editor should show as a small form instead of as source.

tag.description: The element, e.g. YouTube or aside.

name.description: Only needed when two definitions share a tag.

label.description: What the insert menu says. Defaults to the tag.

edit.description: How this block is edited: fields is a small form, table is the table editor (rows, columns, merged cells), source is the element's own HTML in a box with this block's name on it.

attrs.description: Attributes an element must have to be this block, and which are always written, e.g. { "class": "notice" }.

starts.description: Attributes whose value must begin with this, e.g. { "src": "https://www.youtube.com/embed/" } — how one kind of <iframe> is told from another. Only a condition: it is never written for you.

preview.description: Optional image address shown in the editor, with {field} placeholders.

fields.description: The attributes someone fills in. An attribute the file has but this list does not mention is still kept and still editable.

from.description: This field is what sits between the tags, not an attribute.
